before: the prospective start (2026-10-19) and before any TradFi price, return or funding value was computed or viewed (the implementation's live checks report data coverage only)

implementation_choices.b0_b1_costs: 7 bps per side on netted turnover between consecutive target weights (drift back to equal weight is not charged), times leverage; B2 pays 14 bps on gross 1.0 per week, times leverage
implementation_choices.delisted_vs_lag: a held symbol whose last published bar is more than 3 days before the data end is treated as delisted and exits at its last close (flagged delisted_exit_at_last_close); within 3 days it is lag and the book is pending (same convention as near-miss-forward-v1)
implementation_choices.yahoo_failures: a failed Yahoo fetch falls back to the cached series; a formation the cache cannot serve makes B1 pending from that formation on (never a silent drop); a failed SPY fetch makes the calendar check pending
implementation_choices.daily_stamps: a UTC day's return is stamped at 00:00Z of the next day
implementation_choices.universe_file: research/tradfi_perps_forward/universe_v1.json, protected by a sha256 check in the module (LF-normalised)

open_rule: if a stock-book symbol stays unavailable on Yahoo (B1 pending because of it) the watch reports it and the user decides how to resolve it; any resolution applies only to formations after the decision date and is recorded as a further amendment
